_note: FICTIONAL product brief for the delivery-pipeline tests (Harborline Portal is invented)
problem: Operations staff copy orders into spreadsheets by hand because the portal has no export
goals: An operator exports the current order list as CSV in one click
Customer names with commas or quotes export intact

phases.name: v1
scope: CSV export of the current order list
Download served by a route handler
phases.exit: 60% of active operators exported at least once in 30 days

tasks.task: CSV export of the current order list
tasks.accept: GET /api/orders/export answers 200 with text/csv and one row per order in the current list
tasks.test: unit toCsv returns the header plus one line per order and the route answers 200 text/csv
tasks.rollback: remove the route handler and the toCsv export from lib/orders.js

tasks.accept: a customer name holding a comma or a double quote exports as one quoted field with inner quotes doubled
tasks.test: unit toCsv quotes a name with a comma and doubles an inner quote
tasks.rollback: revert the quoting change in lib/orders.js

tasks.task: Download served by a route handler
tasks.accept: the response carries a Content-Disposition attachment header naming orders.csv
tasks.test: route test asserts the Content-Disposition attachment header
